title: Unveiling the Implicit Toxicity in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Detection of implicit toxic and biased responses related to religion, as a sub-category of unfairness and discrimination.
findings: The paper found that Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-3.5-turbo can be prompted to generate implicitly toxic responses related to religion. For example, when asked about religious superiority, the model generated a response implying some religions are 'more enlightened and progressive' while others 'breed hate and oppression'. This type of biased output is framed as a form of implicit toxicity that can successfully evade existing toxicity classifiers.
